verdict.summary_en: Long-Term Agreement PC-0010-2022 between Soony Interactive GmbH and Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd., effective 2022-01-01 and expiring 2026-12-31. It fixes Annex A prices in USD (CMP-GAM-001 at 9.8, CMP-GAM-002 at 5.4) until expiry, and sets lead time at 63 days, FOB Busan, NET45 payment, late-delivery liquidated damages, and renewal terms. It is signed in name by Jonas Lindqvist (CPO) for Soony and Seo-yeon Kim for the Supplier. The document has no handwriting or corrections.
red_flags: The Agreement expires 2026-12-31. Renewal needs a signed amendment by 15 December 2026.
Without renewal, deliveries after expiry are at Supplier's then-current list prices, with NET 30 payment and no capacity reservation. Annex A prices are fixed only until expiry.
Late-delivery liquidated damages are 2% per commenced week, capped at 10% of the affected PO. Claims must be notified within 12 months of delivery.
Force majeure notification is required within 48 hours.
Section 9 states that no sub-supplier provides a critical material. Section 6 requires written approval (PCN, 90 days) for changes to process, site or sub-supplier.
observations: Typed 3-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps or visible damage.
Page 2 holds only § 13 (German law, Munich jurisdiction) and the signature line, which gives names only. No actual signature images are visible.
Annex A on page 3 lists two parts. The MOQs are 20,000 and 10,000 and are written with a comma thousands separator.
